sentences.text:
, the High  Court may be pleased to suspend the operation of impugned order dt.
 14.09.2022 in WP.No.33157 of 2011, Pending disposal of WA No. 1157 of  2023, on the file of the High Court.
The Appeal coming on for hearing,

upon perusing the Petition and the  affidavit filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of GP FOR  LAND ACQUISITION, for the Appellants and of SRI K JYOTHI PRASAD  Advocate for the Respondent No. 1, the Court made the following  ORDER:
Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submits that the land which was assigned to the private respondent is being claimed by another person under the provisions of the Estate Abolition Act.
He would submit that on account of the rival claim the compensation could not be paid to anybody.
In the circumstances, the appellants shall place before this Court the calculation of the compensation that was to be paid and also details of the deposit of such compensation with any Court.

If no such deposit has been made, the appellants shall place before this Court the amount of the compensation that would be paid out to the person who succeeds i in obtaining a declaration of ownership over the land.
Failure to place the above said information before this Court shall require the presence of the respondent-District Collector, Visakhapatnam, before this Court on the next date of hearing.
